preconditions.description: The length of the input string must not exceed 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string must only contain lowercase and uppercase letters and underscores.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(name in stdin for name in ['Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita']) and sum(name in stdin for name in ['Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita']) == 1 else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if the input string contains exactly one of Alex's friends' names, otherwise 'NO'.
